epistemic_role: Exact combinatorial embedding of the source-local 12-qubit star into the paper-normalized periodic L=2 kagome incidence complex; no quantum state or sequential instrument
question: Can the Lab 004 blue/green honeycomb be completed by its contractible hexagonal faces into the three-color kagome star and qubit incidence required by Jing A2 and Iqbal Fig. 2?
source_basis: Jing et al. 2025 Appendix A.1 Eq. A2-A4 and Appendix C.1: red-X errors, blue/green honeycomb, nine stars per source unit cell
Iqbal et al. 2023 Fig. 2 and caption: kagome vertices are physical qubits, one 12-body star has six outer X qubits, six ring CZ factors and two three-body color triangles
fixed_geometry: paper_periodic_honeycomb(2): 24 blue/green star centers and 36 red-qubit edges; 12 contractible six-edge faces become red star centers. Physical kagome qubits are links between differently colored centers in the face-completed triangulation: BG red, BF green, GF blue.

red_edge_cases: every one of the 36 BG edges
one fixed two-edge path through a blue/green center
matrix.independent_unit: the complete deterministic L=2 incidence complex; no stochastic samples

acceptance: All pinned inputs match and the cycle catalog gives exactly 12 distinct contractible six-edge faces, with every BG edge in exactly two faces and every BG vertex in exactly three faces.
The completed complex contains 12 centers per color and 36 physical qubits per color, 108 total, matching nine stars and 27 qubits per paper unit cell at L=2.

Each of 36 stars has a unique six-site alternating-color inner ring, six outer qubits of its own color, six adjacent CZ pairs, and two disjoint three-body Z triangles. Each physical qubit is shared by exactly two star inner rings and two same-color star outer supports, with no duplicated qubit IDs.
The Lab 004 red-edge ID maps one-to-one to a red physical qubit incident on its blue and green endpoint stars; endpoint parity of all 36 one-edge errors and the fixed two-edge path is preserved.
Do not infer ground-space rank, inter-star projector compatibility, conditional E2, logical risk, or a physical five-round schedule from incidence checks.
stop_rule: Fail closed if a pinned source changes, face/edge multiplicity is ambiguous, any ring cannot be uniquely ordered, source-normalized counts or overlap checks fail, or the red-edge identity cannot be preserved. A pass authorizes only a separately registered operator-state and sequential-measurement fixture.
